# Runs of one test binary that differ only in their environment read
# different files. Each keeps its result: running one does not cost the other
# its hit.

env GOCACHE=$WORK/gocache
env WHICH=a
go test -run=TestReadsWhich .
stdout '^ok\s+m\s+[0-9.]+s$'
env WHICH=b
go test -run=TestReadsWhich .
stdout '^ok\s+m\s+[0-9.]+s$'

env WHICH=a
go test -run=TestReadsWhich .
stdout '^ok\s+m\s+\(cached\)$'
env WHICH=b
go test -run=TestReadsWhich .
stdout '^ok\s+m\s+\(cached\)$'

# A changed file is still a miss.
cp changed.txt a.txt
env WHICH=a
go test -run=TestReadsWhich .
stdout '^ok\s+m\s+[0-9.]+s$'

-- go.mod --
module m

go 1.27
-- a.txt --
variant a
-- b.txt --
variant b
-- changed.txt --
variant a, edited
-- m_test.go --
package m

import (
	"os"
	"testing"
)

func TestReadsWhich(t *testing.T) {
	if _, err := os.ReadFile(os.Getenv("WHICH") + ".txt"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
